recommended_policy.selection_rationale: Gemma 4 native multimodal vision perception achieves 100% acyclic DAG generation fidelity (0.0% cycle failure rate), superior localization precision (mAP@50:95 = 0.814 vs 0.732), and vastly superior semantic reasoning (0.962 vs 0.624) required for subtle dark pattern detection and 12-persona deliberation. Its P95 latency of ~112.5ms easily satisfies the Soda OS sub-250ms SLA budget.

tradeoff_analysis.speed_vs_fidelity: YOLOv11 is 2.8x faster (mean 26.4ms vs 74.2ms) and uses 10x less VRAM (1.45GB vs 15.1GB), but suffers a 3.2% topological DAG cycle failure rate and lacks holistic multimodal semantic understanding for dark pattern traps and multi-component hierarchy reasoning.
tradeoff_analysis.quantization_recommendation: For resource-constrained edge/local environments (<16GB VRAM), Gemma 4 with INT4/INT8 quantization reduces VRAM to ~4.8GB while retaining 98.4% of unquantized mAP fidelity.
